depiction.composition: two symbols side by side, flat front view

readings.meaning: pause or resume an ongoing service or subscription
continue watching or listening to media in progress

ambiguity: At very small sizes it can be confused with a skip-forward or step-forward symbol (triangle with a single vertical bar).

reasoning: The icon shows the universal play/pause media transport symbol (a right-pointing triangle next to two vertical bars). It fits tasks about pausing or resuming subscriptions, troubleshooting media playback controls, or resuming partially watched/listened media, though specific media types (video, music, podcasts) usually have more concrete object icons. At small sizes it can be confused with a skip-next icon.
